messages:
Rina Patel: Quick proposal: introduce a 'soft-pin exemption' bucket for tenants with compliance constraints or integrated tokenizers. Purpose: allow model swaps without forcing soft-pin enrollment. Need guardrails so product/ops aren't surprised.

Owen Clarke: Important. What are the criteria to grant exemption vs keep them on soft-pin? Also, how does this impact our deprecation runway? :thinking_face: 

Rina Patel: Criteria idea: 1) legal/regulatory block (DPA/KMS), 2) incompatible embed schema, 3) explicit customer opt-out (contract). Exemptions are temporary (default 90 days) and require documented migration plan in the artifact.

Marta Ivanov: For migrations we must keep a visible "migration_plan" field in the eval artifact with steps + expected impact. Ops needs that to schedule cutovers and know if a shim is available. Example: migration_plan: "shim:yes; shard_migration:2; data_resave_required:no".

Nate Brooks: From infra: the rollout controller needs a single decision call: ALLOW_SOFT_PIN or EXEMPT. We can implement policy rules that read artifact keys: data_processing_approved, embed_compatible, migration_plan_present. If EXEMPT, the model can be swapped only after manual runbook signoff.

security-bot: Checklist missing: DPA_signed, kms_provisioned, encryption_in_transit_verified. If any false -> require exemption path or block.

Owen Clarke: OK. For launch criteria and deprecations: Recommend two tracks: Standard (soft-pin default 14 days, canary 5%, auto-fallback thresholds) and Restricted (exemption required, manual canaries only, longer runway). Document thresholds explicitly.

Rina Patel: Proposed thresholds: quality delta per-slice <= 1.25pp; weighted <= 0.7pp; p95 short <= 250ms; p99 <= 700ms; cost_delta <= +12%. Canary: 3-5% or 20k requests for 7 days. Auto-fallback if anomaly_rate >0.4% for 10m or p95 > +30% baseline for 15m.

Marta Ivanov: For deprecation windows, propose: paid tenants get 30-day notice + migration credits; exempt/restricted tenants get bespoke timelines and must sign migration plan; self-serve gets 7-day notice. Record all notices in artifact.

Nate Brooks: Operational runbook additions: cutover playbook must include: preflight artifact inspection, pre-cutover snapshot of gold traffic, gradual traffic ramp (0.5% -> 1% -> 3% -> 5%), automated health checks at each step, and explicit rollback action that references artifact.audit_id. We'll add APIs: startRamp(rollout_id, steps), pauseRollout(rollout_id), forceRevert(rollout_id, reason).

Rina Patel: Also add a migration-compatibility smoke: run 50 golden queries and verify output_hashes match within tolerance. If mismatch -> mark embed_compatible:false. Artifact should include smoke_report_url and smoke_pass boolean.

security-bot: Add retention note: artifact must be immutable and retained 90 days post-rollout for audits. Also log who granted exemptions and link to signed DPA.

ops-bot: CI: queued bench for model "boreal-rc" job=bmk-299888-01 ETA~3h.

Owen Clarke: One product ask: surface exemption status and migration_plan residual work in the Console so customer success can coordinate. Also expose opt-in for early migration testing.

Marta Ivanov: Agreed. We'll add "console_migration_task" field to artifact linking to tickets.

Rina Patel: Next steps: I'll write a short spec that adds: artifact migration_plan schema, exemption lifecycle, explicit thresholds, and operational APIs. Will post PR for infra and legal to review. If no objections, we ship this as a beta policy for the next catalog sprint. Thanks all. :rocket:
